fall_height_m.notes: 'This wedge then dropped around 1800 m to the Ronti Gad valley floor'

fatalities.notes: 'More than 200 people were killed or are missing' (Shugar et al. 2021); Cook et al. (2021) and Tiwari et al. (2022) also state more than 200 — a lower bound, no upper bound read

bulked_volume_m3.notes: Shugar et al. (2021) describe an 'extraordinarily large and mobile debris flow' scouring 'up to 220 meters above the valley floor' but no bulked volume was read.

dammed_river.notes: Not established in any source retrieved on 2026-09-03; dammed_river was previously recorded as false with that caveat in notes. Null until a fetched source states it either way.

peak_velocity_ms.notes: No flow velocity was read in the retrieved abstracts.

rock_fraction.notes: 'rock and glacier ice' (Shugar et al. 2021); the ratio was not read in the retrieved abstracts.

runout_km.notes: The flow descended the Ronti Gad, Rishiganga and Dhauliganga valleys; no total runout distance was read (the 13 and 19.7 km figures are distances to the two plants).

secondary_surge.notes: Not established in any source retrieved on 2026-09-03; secondary_surge was previously recorded as false with that caveat in notes. Null until a fetched source states it either way.

seismic.magnitude.notes: No catalogue magnitude was read; Cook et al. (2021) discuss detectability, not magnitude.

infrastructure_impacts.description: Shugar et al. (2021): the flow 'severely damaged two hydropower projects'; Rawat et al. (2024) name the Rishiganga Power Corporation 13.2 MW project 13 km from the source
Shugar et al. (2021): 'severely damaging two hydropower projects'; Rawat et al. (2024) name the NTPC Tapovan Vishnugad 512 MW project 19.7 km from the source

name: Chamoli / Ronti Peak rock–ice avalanche and debris flow, Uttarakhand, India
notes: Best-documented reference event and serac's replay/backtest event. Shugar et al. (2021) and Cook et al. (2021) are Science papers whose abstracts were read via the Europe PMC API (the science.org pages are behind a bot challenge); their DOIs resolved via Crossref. Transect ids raini/tapovan are defined by the chamoli-rishiganga AOI.

precursors_observed.description: Tiwari et al. (2022) report a nucleation phase with precursory tremors for 2:30 h before detachment; Rawat et al. (2024) place the nucleation-phase onset at 04:51:18 UTC, after the arrival of surface waves from a M6 earthquake in Davao del Sur, Philippines (04:31:41 UTC)

lead_time_days.notes: Tiwari et al. (2022): 'seismic precursors which were continuously active for 2:30 h prior to main detachment' — 2.5 h expressed in days

seismic.notes: Cook et al. (2021): signals recorded on a regional network in Uttarakhand up to 100 km away. Rawat et al. (2024): nucleation phase at 04:51:18 UTC. No catalogue magnitude was read and the event is not in USGS ComCat as far as retrieved.

source_elevation_m.notes: summit and approximate collapse altitude as stated; the scar elevation itself was not read
